la sbyar ba dang cung mi mthun/ yang dad pa'i rjes 'brang rnams rigs pa'i ma grub par du lung la yid mi ches na chos kyi rjes 'brang dang khyad med du 'gyur bar yang gsungs/ tshe brtan na re/ shin lkog kho na ston pa rnams dpyad pa gsum gyis dpyod tshul gyi dbang du byas zer ba khyod kyi lugs la dpyad pa gsum gyis dpyod pa la don dpyod yul gzhal bya'i gnas gsum yod dgos pas/ shin skog kho na ston pa la dang bo gnyis med pa'i 'gal/ sde bdun rgyan du de tsam gyis dpyad gsum gyis dag par sgrub ces ma gsungs zhes pa dang/ ṭīka chen ltar gyi dpyad gsum dag tshul don gyis tshang zer ba nang 'gal/ tshe brtan sogs shin lkog kho na ston pa yod zer ba 'dul lung lo rgyus lta bur bsam/ 'a dul lung sogs kyi lo rgyus chos can/ shin lkog kho na ma yin par thal/ cung lkog ston pa'i phyir te/ mthar lam ston pa'i phyir te/ bka' yin pa'i 164

phyir/ khu re'i dge bshes dang bgros tshe/ shin lkog kho na ston pa'i bka'i mtshan gzhir rnam mkhyen kho na ston pa bzhag par/ de chos can/ thar lam ston pa ma yin par thal zer/ thar lam cung lkog yin pa dang/ bka' la thar lam ston pas khyab pas bden/ gung thang lugs la/ bka' yin na gzhal bya'i gnas gsum ston pas khyab/ tshe brtan gyis/ shin lkog kho na lung gis sgrub dgos par gsungs pa dang 'gal zer yang/ ga la 'gal te/ gzhal bya'i gnas gsum ston pa de chos can du bzung yang bstan don shin lkog kho na lung gis sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/ mngon sum gyis gnon pa med par grub pa la mngon sum tshad mas grub dgos byas na ṭīka chen dang mthun/ mngon sum tshad ma dang dngos stobs rjes dpag gis ma grub kyang gnod pa med par 'jog tshul zhig yod na/ sgra la mig shes tshad mas gnod pa med par yang bzhag chog par ha cang thal lo/ / tshe brtan/ bden bzhi ston pa'i mdo la gzhal bya'i gnas gsum ka bstan pas ma khyab zer ba cung lkog kho na bstan bsam pa e yin/yin na shin lkog sgrub pa'i mthun dper mi rung/ min na bden bzhi ston pa'i mdo la shin lkog kho na ston pa'i khyab par 'dod dam/ rigs rgyan gyi phyogs chos sgrub tshul ltar na/ rin chen phreng ba las bshad pa'i gzhal bya'i gnas gsum po thams cad rtogs dgos 'dra bas shin tu tshegs che bar 'gyur/ rin phreng gi lung/ rang gi bstan don la mi bslu bar sgrub skabs/ bden bzhi ston pa'i mdo'i steng tu shin lkog rtogs mtshar na/ mthun dpe'i steng du khyab pa nges pa dang 'gal/ shin lkog rtogs tshar na/ de rtags sbyor gang la brten pa yin/ de'i mthun dpe gang yin sogs brtags na dka'/ shin lkog thams cad sgrub byed la dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung rang ldog de ma gtogs med par thal gsungs pa la 'dod lan thebs pa 'dra ste/lung bye brag pa ci 'dra zhig chos can tu bzung yang dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung rang ldog de ma gtogs rtags su 'god rgyu med pa'i phyir/ yig char/ gang zag phal ba la ltos pa'i gang zag la mi rton chos la rton pa zhes pa gang zag phal ba rnams kyis bsam tshod ltar don la ma grub pas yid brtan du mi rung ba la bsams nas ming btags/ gdul bya phal ba rnams kyis bsam tshul ltar bden no snyam du 'dzin mkhan zhig med stabs de la yid rton mi rung gsung mi dgos sam snyam/ go don gang zas si bdag yod par ston yul des bdag yod par zhen pa ltar yid brtan mi rung la/ de dgos pa can gyi gsung du shes nas bdag med la yid rton pa phal ba la ltos pa'i gang zag la mi rton chos la ston pa'i don du bzhag na e bachi/ yig char sgo gsum la 'dzud 165

pa/ rtag brtan ston pa'i mdo'i dgongs don gsungs pa sogs dgos pa dgongs gzhir bzhag pa 'dra zhig snang/ lang gshegs las/ drang ba'i phyir sogs dgos pa dang/ rnam par thar ba gsum gyi spyod yul sogs kyis dgongs gzhi rnam thar sgo gsum bstan nam/ chos bdag dang sogs yig nor 'dra bas dam pa min la bdag 'dzin mchog/ bdag med ston pa ma yin te/ ltar bdag med pas bdag yod par bstan pa mchog ces pa'i don no/ / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yid brtan du rung ba'i yul yin yang/ de gang zag bzang ba tsam rgyu mtshan du byas nas yid mi rton pa'o/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong dang nges don gyi mdo rnams yid brtan 'os pa yin mod/ de rnams ston pa'i bka' yin pa tsam rgyu mtshan du byas nas yid mi rton pa'ang brtag dgos/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gang la mi rton rgyu'i tshig la 'jog par gsungs stabs/ nges don gyi mdo'i tshig tsam la mi rton par don la rton tshul gsal bo ma shar/ gang zag gi bdag yod par ston pa'i mdo'i dgongs gzhi dbu mar gsal/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud don/ tshig legs sbyar gyi sgra yin pa tsam la mi rton par tshig phal ba yin yang don ma nor na yid rton rung tshul bstan/ kur ṇaḍa li gar ḍū'i sgras/ zhes pas don re re la ming mi 'dra ba mang tshul bstan/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ sems can thams cad kyi skad dang yi ge dang snang bar byed pa dang sogs ni skad kyi smra ba dang / yi ges bstan du med pa dang/ sgras ji lta ba bzhin snang bar byed mi nus pa'i don nam yig cha ltar na/ gang zag gi bdag yod par ston pa'i mdo'i sgras zin la yid mi rton par bsam don gyi brjod bya la yid rton pa de gang zag la mi ston chos la rton pa dang/ tshig la mi rton don la rton zer ba gnyis kya'i gzhi mthun yin zer dgos pa 'dra/ byang sa las/ sgo sna tshogs nas zhugs pa'i zhes sogs kyi don ni drang don sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par sgo sna tshogs nas thar bar bgrod thabs bstan pas nges don gyi rnam par dbye ba la nges pa med ces so/ / rigs shes rjes dpag gi snang tshul ltar du gnas lugs su khas mi len zhes pa ltar na/ sbyor lam mnyam bzhag gi snang tshul ltar yang gnas lugs su khas len mi rigs pa de yang rnam shes su 'jog par thal lo/ / stong thun ltar na so skye'i shes pa thams cad rnam shes su 'jog dgos 'dra/ yig char/ gzhi grub na nges don yin pas khyab par bshad la/ legs bshad las/ don la drang nges gnyis dang zhes pa dang 'gal 'dra/ blo gros mi zad pa las/ gang thog ma sems bskyed pa nas zhes sogs kyis tshig la mi rto na zhes pa'i tshig la so skye'i tshig yod par bshad tshul mi 166

gsal bas bshad gzhi las 'khrul lam/ byang sar bstan pa'i don dang/ rigs pa dang zhes 'byung yang/ dka' 'grel du/ chos la rton pa'i rgyu mtshan du rigs pa dang / zhes dang/ don la rton pa'i rgyu mtshan du ba stan pa'i don dang zhes drangs pa byang sa dang/ dka' 'grel gnyis rton pa dang bo gnyis kyi go rim mi mthun pa'i dbang gis yin/ dka' 'grel du/ rton pa bzhi thos bsam sgom gsum sogs la sbyar ba'i khungs dka' ma snyam ste/ byang sar ye shes la rton pa'i skabs/ rnam shes thos bsam dang ye shes sgom par sbyar ba sogs la bsdur na dogs pa che/ dka' 'grel du/ sa'i dngos gzhir gang zag bzhi la sbyar ba dngamyu/ dus bzhi la sbyar ba gnyis gsungs zhes zur du yod 'dra ba zhig 'byung mod/ sa'i dngos gzhir dus bzhi dang/ gang zag bzhi la sbyar ba rton pa bzhi'i don bsdu'i skabs yin pas zer ba min//dka' 'grel du/ dgongs pa bzhi dang ldem dgongs bzhi rton bzhi dang gnad 'dra bar gsungs kyang/ de dag gi drang don bstan snyam pa ma gtogs gang yang ma shar/sa'i dngos gzhir/ rton gzhi'i rnam bzhag bshad kyang tshul 'chos chos la rton gyi gang zag la min pa dang/ don la rton gyi tshig 'bru la ma yin pa thos pa lhur len pa la sbyar ba sogs ma shes/ byang sar rton bzhir bshad/ phal ba'i skabs ni legs sbyar ma yin pa la go/ yig char phal ba'i rton kyang zhes pa'i khungs ma rnyed/ byang sar /nag po bstan pa dang chen po bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin shes nas rigs pa la rton par byed kyi/ gnas brtan nam/ shes pa'i gang zag gam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'am/dge 'dun gyis chos 'di dag bshad do zhes gang zag la rton pa min/ byang sems de pa la dad pa zhen dga' ba zhen gsungs la/ gcig tu mngon par dga' ba dang/nges don gyi mdo la rton gyi drang don la min/ nges don la rton na 'dul ba 'di las mi 'phrog par 'gyur te/ drang don gyi mdo ni sgo sna tshogs nas zhugs pa'i don gyi rnam par dbye ba ma nges pas the tshom bskyed pa yin phyir/ rtogs pa'i ye shes la snying por lta yi thos pa dang bsam pa'i don shes pa tsam la ma yin par gsungs/ yig char/chos phung brgyad khri gsung mkhan gyi byang sems yod par phyir zhes pa/ sangs rgyas la ltos na byang sems/ phal ba yin pas chos la rton gyi gang zag la mi rton pa'i rgyu mtshan nam/ don dam la rton zhes pa gzhung du mi gsal yang yig char bshad/ yig cha'i don/ rig shes rjes dpag la snang ba ltar gnas lugs mthar thug tu khas mi len kyang/ des nges pa ltar gnas lugs mthar thug tu khas len zhes pa'o/ yig char/nges don gyi mdo yin pa'i phyir to blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/167

zhes pa la khyab med kyang pha rol bo'i khas blangs la 'khris/ dbu sems gang gi lugs la'ang/ gsung rab las nges don du gsungs na nges don yin pa'i ma khyab ste/sems tsam lugs la blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las nges don du bshad na nges don yin pa'i ma khyab/ dbu ma'i lugs la dgongs 'grel las nges don du bshad na'ang des ma khyab pa bzhin/ / dge rgyan dka' 'grel du/ dgongs 'grel le'i bcu gsungs pa 'dren dus dgongs pa nges 'grel/ tshul bzhin kun tu dri ba gnyis so sor brtsi/'di nyid de legs bshad las 'og tu gleng gzhi'i le'u zhes 'byung ba mdo gzhan bzhin gleng gzhi rdzogs mtshams nas le'u zhes kyang don gyis 'thob pa la dgongs pa yin tshul gsungs pa gleng gzhi le'u bcu nang du mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan yin/ don thob pa yod na yod pas khyab brtag le'u bcu las lhag pa bcu gcig yod kyang skyon tu mi 'gro bsam/ shes bya'i gnas bcu zer ba dang/ shes bya'i gnas sogs chos bcu zer ba gnyis yod pa las dge rgan phyi ma bzhed/ chos bcu 'dren skabs mtshan nyid gsum so sor brtsi/ drod rtse bzod mchog sogs su kun btags gzhan dbang sogs la 'jug tshul gnyis snang je phrad 'gro ba/ zag med kyi tshul khrims ting nge 'dzin she sa rab rnam par grol ba/ rnam par grol pa'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung bo rnams ni zag med kyi phung bo lnga'o/ gzugs la yid 'byung sogs zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo la sbyor/ phyi ma zag med/ khu re dge bshes la dris par mdzod dus sangs rgyas thob byed kyi lam gsungs pa rnams mdzod kyi tshig tu gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sde snod yin byas na ji 'dra zer/ 'dir bstan 'khor lo dang po'i don gyis 'thob tshod kyi rang mtshan dang/ tshig gis bstan tshod kyi rang mtshan gnyis las/ gzugs sog sa rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa dang bo dang/ gzugs rang mtshan gyis grub pa gnyis par 'jog ces dge rgan gsungs/ 'gres rkang phyes ma phyes zhes pa 'bum par gzugs tshor ba sogs so sor phye ba dang/ nyi khri sogs su phung bo lnga zhes so sor ma phye ba lta bur go 'am/ brjod bya bden bzhir bcoms zhes pa dngos dang brgyud pas bden bzhir 'khrid pa'am bden bzhi stong ba la byas na gsungs rab thams cad der thal pas bden bzhi dngos su ston pa'am/ 'gang na bden bzhir bcoms pa'i mdo yin na bden bzhi dngos su ston pas ma khyab byas na bde/ gzugs skye ba'ang ma yin 'jig pa'ang ma yin zhes pa'i 'gyur mi gcig pa de gzugs can snying bo'i bsu ba zhes pa'i mdor yod mod/ mngon 'byung gi mdo'i 'gyur bde zhes pa'o/ dka' 'grel du/ 'dir bstan 'khor lo dang bo'i sgras zin la rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir 168

rang mtshan gyis grub pa'i skye 'jig sogs bstan par gsung ba yig char/ sgras zin sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'i mdo drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid du bshad pa dang mthun mod/dka' 'grel du/ der skye 'jig yod ces pa tsam las gong 'og gang du'ang rang 'dzin rtogs pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub ces pa'i tshig zur tsam yang med par gsungs pa dang / tshig zin la skye 'jig tsam gsungs kyang/ zhes 'byung bas/rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub tshig zin la ma gsungs na sgras zin la gsungs tshul ji ltar yin brtag/ dka' 'grel las/ brjod don ngo bo la kun btags pa zhes sogs ltar na brjod bya'i gtso bo la dngos bstan du byas nas 'khor lo dang bo de dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa min yang sgras zin sgra ji bzhin pa yin te tshig zin la skye 'jig tsam gsungs pa'i phyir/ byas e chog snyam yang yig char dngos su 'gal pa'i brtag/ dka' 'grel las/ gdul bya der skye 'jig sogs yod par bstan tshad/ rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyi grub par ston mi dgos gsungs mod/ 'khor lo dang bo'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya der rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par ma bstan pa'i 'jig yod par bstan pa zhig bzhag dka' 'am dpyad/ dka' 'grel du/ dbang sgyur ba bo'i bdag dang sogs rang skya ba'i rdzas su 'dzin tshul dang de'i gzhir rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin pa dgos tshul gsungs/ rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir zhes pa'i rtog pa ni don mthun yin 'dra ste/ gzugs so snyam pa dang / gzugs kyi skye pa'o snyam du 'dzin pa la byed pas so/ / rab 'byor le'u las/ dmigs pa'i mngon par rtog pa zhes chos kyi bdag 'dzin dang/ shes bya brda sprod par bgyid sogs sgra rtog gi gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par zhen pa'am snyam yang rtog log tu gsal/zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa re zhig 'dzin tu ma bcug na zhes pa de re zhig bkag na zhes pa'o/ sems/ 'grel las/ 'jig rten na ni dpyod pa 'jig/ ces pa ma dag gam/ 'jug ces pa'o/ rtog pa'i zhen gzhi rang mtshan gyis grub par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi gang zag gi bdag med 'jog par bshad pa 'og tu gang zag gi bdag med kyi dbang tu byas pa'i mtshan nyid gsum po 'khor lo dang bo'i dgongs gzhir bshad pa ltar te/ mdo gzhan la sgro 'dogs kyi yul yod par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhir yod pa zhig dang skur 'debs ltar 'thad par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhir dgag pa zhig 'jog mod/ 'dir smra pa'i dgongs gzhir dgag pa bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan ma shes/ dang bo'i sgras zin ltar 'dzin pa'i blo med lta sel pa'i thabs su 169

'gro bar gsungs kyang/ de chos kyi bdag 'dzin shes sgrib yin pa'i thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i thabs su 'gro bar thal/ med lta sogs sel pa'i thabs su 'gro ba'i phyir snyam/ dka' 'grel du/ bsdu ba las gsungs pa ru ra'i mdo la brten pa yin tshul dang/ rgyan gyi brten pa'ang de ka yin pa dang/ dgongs 'grel gyi dri ba 'god pa ni khams mang bo'i mdo yin par bshad mod/ lung rnams la dpyad na ba ru ra'i mdor gsungs pa 'jig rten gyi khams dang/ mdo sde rgyan las bshad pa sems can gyi khams dang/ bsdu ba las bshad pa khams bco brgyad yin 'jug pas/ / bsdu ba dang mdo rgyan ba ru ra rnams don gcig tu sgrub dka' 'am snyam/ bsdu ba (si)bar drangs pa'i dgongs 'grel las/ rab 'byor nag khrod cig tu gnas tshe de'i dge slong rnams phan tshun nas mchis shing mjal nas chos rnam pa sna tshogs dmigs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ston pa'i shes pa brda sprod par bgyid de /kha cig phung bo la dmigs pa dang sogs dka' 'grel du drangs pa ltar ches mang rgya nag 'grel chen (ti) pa las/ brda sprod par byed pa nga rgyal gyi dngos bo'i nas pa brtan par bshad pa dang/ nga rgyal med pa la yang de 'dra'i nus pa yod par bshad pas/ dge slong rnams kyi phan tshun la chos sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa skyes tshul bshad pa la shes pa brda sprod pa zer 'dra/ dka' 'grel du/bden bzhi'i chos 'khor dris zhus kyi bden pa las bcoms pa'i mtshan gzhir gsungs pa ltar na de'i sgras zin la bden bzhi rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa 'jog dgos stabs de bstan don la bslu bar 'gyur bas yig cha sogs las bden bzhi'i chos 'khor de dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung gi rtags kyis shin lkog ston pa'i mdo rang gi bstan don la mi bslu bar sgrub pa'i rtags chos gnyis ldan gyi mthun dpe yang dag tu bshad pa dang 'gal pa'i dpyad/ legs bshad las/phyi rol don snang gi bag chags sam sa bon dang de'i dbang gis phyi don du snang ba la dgongs nas mig dang gzugs kyi skye mched yod par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'i don ni/theg dman gyi mdo de dag gi brjod bya'i don du mi rung bar bshad pa ma gtogs/de'i bstan don dgongs gzhi de la mi bslu byas e chog snyam yang de mi rung bas brtag/legs bshad du/ gzugs sogs ye med yum gyi don min par gsungs pas ye med sgras zin gyi don yin yang brjod bya'i don min pa 'og tu pha ma bsad bya de 'dra'i sgras zin yin yang brjod bya'i don min par bshad pa dang 'dra/ dka' 'grel las/'dir khams drug las ma smros zhes pa dgongs 'grel du khams bco brgyad las gzhan 170

pa'i khams drug ma gtogs bzhi tshan sogs ma smros zhes pa'o/ khams drug skyes bu'i gdags gzhir bshad kyang de re re ba gdags gzhi min nam snyam ste de yin na rkang lag sor mo sogs kyi sdug bsngal phra mo'i bar re re nas skyes bu'i gdags gzhi yin zer dgos pas de thams cad la btags pa'i btags chos yod par thal lo/ / phung lnga tshogs pa gdags gzhi yin na ma gtogs re re ba gdags gzhir bzhag dka' 'am tshegs che/ rkang lag sogs ngo bo tha dad pa yin phyir btags chos gang zag kyang ngo bo tha dad pa yin par thal pa sogs mang/ yig cha dka' 'grel sogs ltar na 'khor lo dang bo'i phung sogs dang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub mnyam tu bstan byas na/ des rang mtshan gyis grub par gsung bar thal pa dang/ sgras zin sgra ji bzhin pa'i mdor thal pas/ 'khor lo dang bor chos rnams la rang mtshan gyis grub pa yod ces pa'i tshig yod mnyam yin pa'i don zhes zhib cha mdzad/ 'o na 'khor lo dang bor phung sogs rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa yod ces pa'i tshig gis de brjod ma brjod dang/brjod na sgra ji bzhin par thal pa sogs sngar dang 'dra bas zhib chas go e chod/ kha cig phung bo rnams kyi rang mtshan nyid kyang zhes pa'i rang mtshan de phung sogs kyi steng du yod la kun btags kyi steng du med pa zhig yin pa'i phyir sogs/ rje btsun pa sogs kyis khas blangs chog snyam/ rje btsun pa'i 'dir bstan 'khor lo dang bos gzugs sogs rang 'dzin rtogs pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par yang gsungs/gzugs sogs rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par yang gsungs zer/ dka' 'grel du/dang mtshan gyis grub pa la byed gsungs pa'ang dgag bya'i rang mtshan gzhir bzhag yin zhes pa yig cha dang bstun ched ma gtogs/ dngos gnas la rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa la byed pa kun btags skabs kyi gzhung du gsal/ dka' 'grel du/ kun btags dmigs kyis bsal pa'i dgos pa yod de 'jog mi thub pa'i phyir ro/ zhes pa la khyab pa mi 'dra ste/ yongs grub dmigs kyis bsal pa'i dgos pa yod de/dgongs 'grel las/ yongs grub don dam pa ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni 'khor lo dang bo'i sgras zin 'gog ched yin pas de'i rang mtshan de yod na 'jog tshul phyi ma'i don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa 'di 'jog mi thub pa'i phyir ro/ zhes so/ /don phung sogs rang 'dzin rtogs pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa de/mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa'i med rgyu yang yin/ don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa phyi ma'i med rgyu yang yin pas so/ / dka' 'grel/ de'i rang mtshan de yod na zhes pa/rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' stsal zhes pa'i rang mtsha na de yod na zhes pa'o/ dka' 171

'grel du/ ma khyab gsungs pa yig char bstun ched yin don la rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' stsal/ ces pa dang/ rang mtshan gyis grub pa la gsungs zhis pa dang/rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam par gnas pa ni ma yin zhes pa'i rang mtshan rnams don gcig min thabs med pa gzhung la bltas na gsal/ legs bshad du/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa chos kyis bdag med du bshad pa'i shugs kyis gzhan dbang la ngo bo dang khyad par du btags pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag 'dzin du bstan la zhes gsal bar gsung mod yongs grags pa mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa kun btags dang don gcig pas chos kyi bdag med min zer/ de chos kyi bdag med du khas blangs na kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub pa dang/ gzhan dbang la ngo bo khyad par du btags pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub pa gnyis chos bdag tu 'gro tshul zhig yod dam/ 'di rang bzo/ rje btsun pa rnams gzugs gzugs zhes pa'i ming gi gdags gzhi yin pa la bsams nas gzugs gzugs kyi gdags gzhi yin zer/ bdag yongs su zhu lags so zhes pa'i tshig 'di 'khor lo dang bo dang bar ba'i dri ba zhu byed yin la tshig de dngos su byung yang tshigs des 'khor lo dang bo'i dri ba dngos su zhus pa min te/ des bar ba'i dgongs gzhi dngos su zhus nas dang bo'i dgongs gzhi shugs la zhus pa'i phyir/ dka' 'grel las/ snga ma rnam shes kyi thos tshul dang sogs kyi don ngag tu ma thon par thugs la bzhugs pa'i rgyan de rnam shes kyis thos tshul yod med/ ngag tu ma thon na ngag sgra min dgos pas zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur ba'i sgra ma yin par thal lo/ / sogs so/ / dka' 'grel las/ rang mtshan gyis grub pa dang zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa gnyis phyogs mi 'dra'ang zhes sogs kyi don sgo mang dang mthun par bshad na kun btags rang mtshan gyis grub na rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub dgos pa las kun btags rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par khas len mi rigs pa'i phyir te/ dgongs 'grel 'dir gzhan dbang kun btags kyis stong ba yongs grub tu byas pa yin pa'i zhes sogs sbyar na e 'grigs ma gtogs dka'/ yang na tshe brtan gyis bshad pa dang mthun par byas chog 'dra/ tshe brtan gyis 'khor lo dang bo rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub mnyam du gsungs zhes pa'i rang mtshan gzhung las khas len rgyu'i rang mtshan la bshad pa ltar snang yang don dgag bya'i rang mtshan la byed dgos tshul/ kun btags mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med par bshad pa'i kun btags dang dgongs/ gzhi dris pa'i rang mtshan du grub rgyu ni gzugs sogs ngo bo dang khyad par du 'dogs pa'i rtog pa'i zhen 172

gzhi yin pa la go dgos/ spyi mtshan sogs kun btags rang ga pa rnams de min zer ba go rgyu che/ gzugs sogs rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa kun btags mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med par bshad pa'i don dang/gzhan dbang kun btags kyis stong ba yongs grub tu bshad pa'i don yin na de yin pas khyab par bshad/ gzugs sogs kun btags kyis stong ba dang/ de dag rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis stong ba dang/ de dag rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin nga/ rang mtshan gyis ma grub pa rnams tshig brjod tshul tsam las don la khyad med zer ba dgongs dag/ sgo mang lugs la kun btags dang mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa don gcig zer/ khungs gar yod tshod/ tshe brtan gyis/ sngon bo rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa rang mtshan gyis grub ba'am/ kun btags rang mtshan gyis grub pa chos bdag tu 'jog par bshad pa rje btsun yig cha dang mthun/ rje btsun mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa stong nyid du bshad pa yod tshod/ dka' 'grel du dang bo cha ma phye ba zhes dang/bar bas cha ma phye par zhes sogs legs bshad du mi gsal/ legs bshad las/ngo bo dang khyad par du kun btags pa'i kun btags ni chos kyi khams dang skye mched yin pas de gnyi sa la ma phye ba rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par gsungs pa yang drang don no/ / zhes pa'i de gnyis ni chos khams dang chos kyi skye mched gnyis yin 'dra/gzugs sgra sogs lnga bo ma gtogs pa'i chos thams cad chos khams dang chos kyi skye mched yin pas/ de la sems tsam lugs kyi rang mtshan gyis grub ma grub gnyis yod mod/ de lta ba'i khyad ma phye bar thams cad rang mtshan gyis grub par gsungs pa drang don yin pa'i don byas na/ de 'dra'i khyad par phye nas ston pa nges don du 'gro pas brtag/ des na phye ma phye dpyad/ yig cha'i chos 'a khor thad du rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par bstan pa'i 'khor lo dang bo dang / phyi don yod par bstan pa'i 'khor lo dang bo gnyis 'gal bar bshad pa dang bstun ched dka' 'grel du gnyis/ ka dngos bstan la ma sbyar na zhes zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa dngos su bstan pa dang/ phyi don dngos su ston pa'i mdo gnyis 'gag pa'i don du sbyar mod/ legs bshad las/ 'khor 'o/ dang bo phyi don gsungs pa drang don yin tshul dang / kun btags rang mtshan gyis grub par gsungs pa yang drang don yin tshul shin tu gsal pas/ de gnyis don gcig byas na bde/ legs bshad du/ phung sogs kyi chos la nyung shas zhig ma gtogs/ bden par grub pa ma bkag ces pa/ 'og tu/ gang zag la rang ba'in bkag mas phung bo la phal cher ma bkag 173

pa dang zhes pa dang don gcig pas/ gang zag gi bdag med ston pa'o/ 'khor lo dang bo gang zag la bden grub bkag zer mi rung bas zhib cha dpyad/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la sbyor tshul yod med brtag/ gang zag gi bdag med stong nyid yin pas gang zag gi bdag med rgyas par bstan na stong nyid rgyas par bstan pas khyab pas yig char theg dman gyi mdo yin na stong nyid rgyas par dngos su ma bstan pas khyab gsungs pa brtag/ 'ga' res theg dman 'phags pas gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs/ de stong nyid yin mod/ des stong nyid ma rtogs zer ba ltar na/ chos gcig gi stong nyid rtogs na stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyab zer dgos 'dra/ rje btsun yig char/ gzugs sogs rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par bstan na gzugs sogs rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par bstan pas khyab cing / gzugs zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa yin na gzugs rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin mi dgos zer/ legs bshad las/ ma phye bar zhes sogs yig char khams bco brgyad la cham phye par rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan du drangs pa mi 'grel/ yig char bden bzhi'i chos 'khor sgra ji bzhin par bshad pa dka' 'grel dang rgyab 'gal/ yig cha ltar na bden pa rnams kyi zhes pa'i dngos bstan bzhag dka'/ yig char phung bo zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyi grub pa med rgyu'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid la 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan du/legs bshad las/ med rgyu'i mtshan nyid sogs drangs pa mi 'gro/ de man chad kyis kun tu btags tshul sogs kyang yod rgyu'i kun btags yin 'dra pas med rgyu'i dgag bya la drangs pa mi 'grel snyam/ zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa bkag pas rnam rig tsam la 'jug pa de gnyis ston pa'i mdo gnyis 'gal pa'i rgyu mtshan du 'gro dka' /yig char/ nyan thos sde bas 'dus ma byas rnams rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par khas mi len zhes pa rang spyi gnyis kyi nang tshan rang mtsha na du mi 'do da pa la bsam kyang de lugs la de khegs na yod par 'jog mi shes pas dpyad/ yig cha kun btags kyi chos rnams kyi spyi zhes pa'i kyi ma dag/ rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa bye brag yin/ gcig shos pu wang gi sgra sgra'i bye brag yin pa la bsam/spyis stong bar nges la bye brag gi stong bar nges pas khyab tshul dbu ma'i bden gnyis thad dam dogs gcod yod/ legs bshad las/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi rang bzhin med do gsungs pa rnams ngo bo nyid med pa gsum du 'du zhes pa'i don chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi ngo bo nyid med pa rnams ngo bo 174

nyid med pa gsum du 'du pa'i don no/ / gzhung las/ ming brda la ltos nas bzhag pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis med pa dang ming brda la ltos nas bzhag pa yin pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis yod par 'jog pa ches gsal pas yig char med rgyu'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid dgag bya chos bdag la sbyar ba 'di dang 'gal te 'di'i med rgyu ming brda la brten nas ma bzhag pa la byed dgos pas so/ / gzhung las/ bzhag pa la yang yod pas ma khyab ces pa'i skyon la dgag bya chos bdag 'jog/ / lugs 'di'i rang mtshan du 'dzin pa la thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi rang mtshan du 'dzin pa tshang gsungs pa sems tsam pa'i lugs yin na thal 'gyur lugs kyi rang mtshan du 'dzin pa blo don mthun yin pas de 'dra'i rang mtshan du 'dzin pa de blo don mthun dang don mi mthun gnyis kur thal lo/ / dka' 'grel du/ yig char bstun nas mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa stong nyid yin zer ba la dgag pa mang mdzad kyang sgro 'dogs bye brag tu dgag pa'i thad du mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa chos kyi bdag med du gsal bar gsungs/ legs ldan lugs la gzhi grub na mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid yin pas khyab pas/mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa med/ 'on kyang dgongs 'grel las bshad pa'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa stong nyid yin pas/ de'i dgag bya kun btags ni don dam par grub pa la byed pas nam mkha'i me tog gi dpe yang de la sbyor 'dra/ lugs 'dir mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa chos kyi bdag med min na yig char med rgyu'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid phung sogs rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa la bshad pa dang 'gal de med rgyu'i chos bdag yin na de med pa stong nyid yin pa las 'os med pas so/ /des na dka' 'grel du/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa chos can/ khyod kyi dgag bya rang nyid gang gis stong ba yongs grub tu 'jog pa'i ska bas kyi dgag byas khyab par thal/zhes pa'ang khas len la khad/ yig char/ dngos bstan gyi de cho sa kyi bdag med phra mo la 'jog par bshad pa'i don dka' 'grel du mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa'i don stong nyid du 'gro ba la sbyar kyang / yig cha rang las dngos ba stan gyi mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa'i med rgyu shes bya la mi srid pa dang / de yin na zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pas khyab par gsungs pa dang 'gal/ don stong nyid du gsungs pa de'i mtshan nyid la zer 'dra pas/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid tshad mas ma dmigs pa stong nyid du thal/ de de'i don yin pas so snyam du dogs/ mdo las rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam par gnas pa ni ma yin zhes pa'i mi gnas rgyu dang / mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa'i med rgyu gnyis don gcig dgos kyang yig cha ltar na snga ma rang mtshan gyi grub pa 175

dang / phyi ma dgag bya chos bdag la sbyar bas mi 'dra zer dgos/ 'on kyang dka' 'grel du dgag bya'i rang mtshan la mi byed par sogs kyi rgyu mtshan du kun btags la med rgyu'i mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo nyid ni sogs drangs pa ltar na de gnyis don 'dra dgos/yig char rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par sgro btags pa zhes pa'i khungs rje'i gsung du rnyed dka'/ legs bshad las/ de la chos kyi bdag tu sgro btags pa kun btags dang zhes pa dang chos kyi bdag tu sgro btags pa'i kun btags 'di ma shes na sogs rgyu mtshan du e 'gro dpyod/ zer rgyun la sgro btags pa de yod rgyu'i kun btags yin zer sgro 'dogs pa po chos kyi bdag 'dzin red/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin des sgro btags pa ltar ma grub pa chos kyi bdag med los yin mod/ de ltar sbyar ba la dgos gal lhag po ma mthong / dka' 'grel du/ mdor bstan dngos bstan gyi mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid la zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par sgro btags pa dang /der grub pa gang rung yin pas khyab par bshad pa yig cha dang bstun ched yin mod/gzhung las med rgyu'i mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo nyid ni rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub pa'am gnas pa la bya'o/ zhes pa dang yig char snga ma'i med rgyu de shes bya la mi srid ces pa dang 'gal/ gnas pa ni rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rnam par gnas pa ni ma yin zhes pa'i gnas pa'o/ zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa mdor bstan dngos bstan gyi mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid yin na/ de chos can rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa yin par thal/ de'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab 'dra ste/ go rgyur zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa chos bdag yin/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid yin zhes pa sogs rtag pa mtha' bzung yin pa ma gtogs gnas tshod la zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa'ang zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa med pa yin pas so/ / bden grub bden med du 'dod pa bzhin no/ / tshe brtan gyis/ zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa chos kyi bdag med dang / chos bdag gnyis ma'i mtshan gzhi yin thal lo/ / zer ba zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa med rgyu'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid yin byas pa la tshig 'khri'o/ zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa mdor bstan gyis dngos su bstan na rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan yod par dngos su bstan pa'i 'khor lo tha ma yod par thal ba sogs so/ / 'on kyang zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa de mdor bstan dngos bstan gyis kun btags dang / de'i dngos bstan gyi med rgyu'i kun btags yin dgos pas/ de'i dngos bstan gyi med pa yin par thal lo zhes na dogs/ dka' 'grel las/ tshig la zhib cha zhes pa ma shes/ sbyir btang 176

mtshan gzhi zhes pa la yod pa zhig dgos kyang / chos bdag de mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa'i mtshan gzhi yin gsungs pa 'dra/ don sbyor skabs/ kun btags spyi tsam rtsod gzhir bzung ba la dgag pa byas pa/ dgongs 'grel las/ ngo bo dang khyad par du btags pa'i kun btags ma gtogs/ kun btags gzhan dngos su ma bstan pa la bsam/ yon tan 'byung gnas kyi le'u drangs pa sgro btags pa'i rgyu mtshan du 'gro dka'/ sgro 'dogs dgag pa'i skabs su/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa chos kyi bdag med du bshad pa dang / kun btags rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag 'dzin tu bshad pa dang / des ngo bo dang khyad par du btags pa'i kun btags rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin tshul sogs shin tu gsal par bshad pas/ kun btags mtshan nyid med pa stong nyid min byas na de thams cad dang rgyab 'gal/ nam mkha' sogs ming brdas bzhag tsam min/ rtog pas btags pa tsam yin zer ba rje btsun pa ste/ khungs gzhung las/ mang bo zhig ming brdas bzhag mi nus pa'i yod pa yin yang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub pa min te/ rtog pas btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes pa la brten pa yin yang de nam mkha' sogs ming brda tsam gyis 'jog mi nus kyang / sgra rtog gis btags pa tsam yin zhes pa'i don du gsal/ ri bong can zla ba zhes pa'i sgras brjod du rung ba 'dod pa tsam gyi 'grub par gsungs pa ni ri bong can la chos gzhan thams cad gyi ming gis brjod rung ba ni de thams cad kyi ming gis brjod pa yo da pa tsam byed 'dra/ rtags la dpyad na'ang shes/de la de'i sgra 'jug mi 'jug lta bu tshul ldan la tshul 'chal gyis sgras brjod mi rung ba sgra mi 'jug pa dang / brjod na nyes pa bskyed pa'i cha nas so/ / brtag tshe brtan lugs la kun btags kyi steng du 'gog rgyu'i rang mtshan de gzhan dbang gi steng du ma grub zer dgos 'dra ste/ de brtag pa mtha' bzung gis grub na chos bdag tu 'jog pas so/ / mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa stong nyid yin na dgongs 'grel du/mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa gang yin dris pa'i lan du kun btags der 'jog par bshad pas/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par thal/yongs grub yin pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ rang mtshan gyis ma grub par thal/ming brdas bzhag tsam yin gyis rang gi mtshan nyid kyi ma grub pa'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pas gnod min dpyad/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa'i mtshan gzhi gzhan dbang steng gi yod rgyu'i kun btags de rang mtshan gyis ma grub pa'i don yin byas na'ang chog pa 'dra/ lhag mthong las semes tsam pas de med 177

pa kun btags la 'dod ces pas mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa kun btags su bstan e yod gsungs mod de ni dka' ba 'dra/ thar gsal las/ sgra las byung ba'i grags pa dang zhes gsungs pa la dgos pa yod de/ rjod byed sgra yis brjod rung du grub pa 'di don gang la yang mi 'grub pa min no/ / zhes de ltar shes pa'i ched du gsungs pa'i phyir/ de don gang la yang mi 'grub pa ma yin par thal/ rjod byed kyi sgra ni brda la brten pa can yin la/ brda de yang 'dod pa tsam la brten pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ mtshan nyid gsum la bden par grub ma grub kyi khyab par yod kyang / rang mtshan gyis grub mnyam yin zer ba des dgongs 'grel ma mthong ngam/nyan thos sde pa'i lugs la kun btags rang mtshan gyis grub par thal/ de rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa'i phyir/ gsungs mkhan rje btsun yin/ sgo mang lugs la/ nyan thos sde ba'i gzugs sogs rang 'dzin rtogs pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par mi 'dod zer bas/ gzhung las/brda'i gnas su rang mtshan gyis grub pa khegs na yod par 'jog mi shes zhes pa'i lung don zhen gzhir gnas tshod kyi grub pa khegs na yod par 'jog dka' ba'i don zer mod/ de'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa 'dod par thal/ der gnas tshod kyis grub par 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste de de'i don yin par stong thun las bshad pa'i phyir byas na cung dka' yang / stong thun du legs bshad snying bor bshad pa'i don du gsung ba ma gtogs/ zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa'i don min zer ram/ dka' 'grel du/ bden grub bkag kyang yod par 'jog mi shes zhes pa'i mi ma dag gam/ kun btags chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir zhes pa mdo sde bas gzhi grub na rang mtshan gyis grub pas khyad par 'dod pa la thal pa 'phangs/ dka' 'grel du/ gong du ma khyab ces pa des yod na rang ngos nas grub pas khyab par 'dod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i mtshams su ma khyab pa'i don no/ / sbyir cha med kyis stong ba rtogs na zhes sogs kyis pha rol la khyab 'grigs 'phen tshul skabs spyi bye brag sbyor ma shes/ sems can yin na rtag gcig rang dbang can gyis stong ba rtogs pas khyab par thal pa'i rgyu mtshan chos gang yang rung ba zhig cha bcas su rtog pas khyab pas so /legs bshad las/ zhen yul gyi rang ldog ces pa la zhen yul rang 'jog/ sgo mang /kun btags rang mtsha na gyis ma grub pa mdo sde bas rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan mthar thug/gzhungalas zhen yul gyi rang ldog spyi mtshan dngos bor med pa mdo sde bas grub ces pa 'di yin/ mdo sde ba'i lugs la sngo 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen yul spyi mtshan yin/ sngon 178

po de zhen yul du song ba'i cha yang spyi mtshan yin/ tshe brtan lugs la/ rang ldog rang mtshan gyis grub pa 'gog na zhes pa rang mtshan yin pa 'gog na zhes lung don 'jog/ legs bshad las/ rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa de rang mtshan gyis grub pa la skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes nyan thos sde dag smra mod/ ces pa dka' 'grel las/gzugs gzugs 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin par rang mtshan gyis grub pa zhes sbyar ba stabs bde/ dka' 'grel las/ mdo sems gnyis gas kun btags sems tsam lugs kyi rang mtshan der ma grub par 'dod gsungs mod/ legs bshad sngon po'i thad las/ sngon po tha snyad kyi gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyi ma grub par zhes pa'i chos kyi bdag 'dzin de'i 'dzin stangs thad ldan du don smra sde gnyis kyang 'dod par bshad pa dang 'gal 'dra/ des na dka' 'grel du gsungs pa sgo mang dang bstun ched/ dbu ma'i yig char/ sems tsam pa'i kun btags rang mtshan gyis med par smra ba rdzun tshig yin par bshad pas/ des der ma gtogs par thal/ rtogs na rdzun tshig min par thal sogs 'phangs na dka'/ tshe brtan ltar mdo sde bas kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par 'dod zhes na/ sems tsam pa'i lugs gzhir zhog/ mdo sde ba'i kun btags bden grub tu 'dod par thal/ de'i phyir/khyab ste/ de'i lugs la bden grub rang mtshan dngos po rnams don gcig yin pa'i phyir sogs spro/ yang 'di ltar de ni ming dang brdas bzhag pa'i mtshan nyid yin gyi zhes sogs mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo nyid med pa'i rgyu mtshan ma yin par thal/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa rang mtshan gyis grub pa'i phyir zhes na/ de mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa rang mtshan gyis med pa'i rgyu mtshan min/ kun btags mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yin zer dgos 'dra/ spyir tshe brtan zer ba ltar kun btags mtshan nyid med pa yongs grub yin zhes na sngon po'i thad kun btags mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa chos kyi bdag med dang / de'i bzlog zla 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag 'dzin tu shin tu gsal bar ma zad/ rang rgyud pa 'i thad du'ang / gzhan du na rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs la yang gzhan dbang ngo bo dang khyad par du btags pa'i ngo bo rang gi mtshan nyi da kyis ma/ grub pa la kun btags mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med par bshad du mi rung ba'i phyir ro sogs mang / dka' 'grel du/ sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin pa la thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi rang mtshan gyis/ grub par 'dzin pa'i 'dzin tshul tshang ba dang / / gzugs phyi rol don du yod par 'dzin pa la yod pa'i 'dzin tshul tshang yang blo don mthun gyis 'dzin tshul tshang ba min gsungs 179

pa dpyad de/ blo don mthun gyi 'dzin tshul yod par thal/ de'i 'dzin tshul tshang ba'i phyir na/ ma khyab zer 'dra/ phyi don yod 'dzin la yod par 'dzin pa'i blo'i 'dzin tshil tshang bar thal/ yod pa'i 'dzin tshul tshang ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ blo don mthun gyi 'dzin tshul med pa 'gal/ de'i 'dzin tshul la phyin ci log gis ma bslad pa'i don mthun gyi cha cung zad kyang med pa dang / thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi de'i 'dzin tshul tshang ba 'gal/ 'di'i rang gi mtshan nyid kyi grub pa yod na sogs kyi don/ rje btsun mtha' dpyod las/ gzhi de rnam rig pa'i 'dod pa ltar gyi rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin pa rgyud ldan yin na/ gzhi de thal 'gyur ba'i 'dod ltar gyi rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin pa rgyud ldan yin pas khyab pa'i don du bshad pa stabs bde/ yig char/ sher mdo sgra ji bzhin pa yin par thal/ kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub par bstan pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab gsungs pa/ gong du 'dir bstan 'khor lo dang bos gzugs rang gis mtshan nyid kyis grub pa ra bstan na/ sgra ji bzhin par thal par bshad pa'i 'gal 'dra/ kun btags rang mtshan gyi ma grub pa chos can/ chos kyi bdag med phra mo yin par thal/ sogs ha cang thal ba 'phangs pa yin/ gzhi grub tshul thams cad gang zag gi bdag med du bshad pa gang zag gi bdag gis stong ba la bsam/ bdag med phra mo gnyis 'gal bar bshad pa sogs/ bdag med phra mo zer ba phra ba'i bdag gi stong ba'i de bzhin nyid du 'gro ba la bsam/ rang mtshan nges pa'i gang zag yin na/ rang mtshan rang mtshan du nges pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab par bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ma go / yig char/ ma khyab ces pa gzugs gzugs zhes pa'i sgra 'jug gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa de dngos bstan yin na/ ngo bo dang khyad par tu btags pa'i kun btags de'i dngos bstan yin pas ma khyab ces pa'o/ 'dod mi rigs zhes pa kun btags kyis chos rnams 'di'i dngos bstan yin par 'dod mi rnams pa'o/ yig char/ gzugs gzugs zhes pa'i sgra 'jug gzhir rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du grub pa gang zag gi bdag med kyi dbang du byas pa'i kun btags su bshad pa'i khungs rnyed dka'/ rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal las/ de yang lugs de dag gis nyan rang gis gang zag rdzas yod du med par rtogs par 'dod kyang / rnam shes gnyis po rdzas yod du med par rtogs par mi 'dod pas/ gang zag rang skya thub pa'i rdzas su med par smra ba ni gang zag gi rang gi ldog pa nas 'dod pa yin gyi gang zag gi mtshan gzhi rnam shes la de ltar 'dod pa min no/ / zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa ltar sems tsam lugs la 180

rdzas yod dang rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod don gcig par bzhed/ kun gzhi rnam shes dang / mtshan gzhi rnam shes gnyis rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du bzhed/ 'on kyang sgo mang gis rang skya 'dzin thub pa'i rdzas yod dang rdzas yod don gcig/ rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod shes bya mi srid zer/ rang skya 'dzin zhes pa la khungs med tshul dang la ldan sogs kyis bshad/ rje'i lugs la/ gzugs kyi steng gi gang zag gi bdag med ni gzugs 'jig lta lhan skyes kyi 'dzin tshul ltar ma gru ba pa'o/ gsungs mkhan yod pa 'thad ldan 'dra/ gzhi bsdu par drangs pa'i dgongs 'grel(zi) las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci las dgongs nas/ gzugs ni yod do/ / rnam par shes pa'i bar yang yod do/ / mi rtag par yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo / / zhes gsungs zhe na/ smras pa/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa nyid las dgongs te gsungs so/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar rtag pa med par yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo / / zhe gang gsungs pa de ni mi rtag par yod par yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo / / zhes gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / bcom ldan 'das kyis ci las dgongs nas/ gzugs ni yod do/ / rnam par shes pa'i bar yang yod do/ /sdug bsngal bar yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo / / zhes gsungs zhe na/ smras pa/skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa nyid dang / don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa nyid las dgongs te gsungs so/ / zhes gsungs/ phyi ma'i don 'khor lo dang bor de ltar bstan pa gzhan dbang dang yongs grub rang mtshan gyis grub pa dgongs te gsungs pa'i don nam snga ma'i don rgya nag 'grel chen du e gsal/ gzhi bsdu ba las/ chos rnams kyi kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ ji tsam tu rjes su tha snyad gdags pa'i phyir/ming dang brdas chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid dam bye brag tu ming dang brdar rnam par bzhag pa gang yin pa'o/ yon tan 'byung gnas chos rnams kyi gzhan gyi dang bo'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ chos rnams kyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba nyid de/ 'di lta ste 'di yod pas 'di 'byung la/ 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ba 'di lta ste/ ma rigs rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba nas/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung bo chen po 'ba' zhig 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes bya ba'i bar gang yin pa'o/ yon tan 'byung sa/nas chos/ rnams kyi yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ cho sa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rdzun pa'i rgyu dang / legs par tshul bzhin yod la byas pa'i rgyus de rtogs shing / de rtogs pa goms par byas pa yang dag par grub pas kyang bla ma med pa yang dag par rdzog sa pa'i 181

byang chub kyi bar du yang dag bar grub pa gang yin pa'o/ zhes gsungs/ grangs las gsungs pa'i don bsdu na/ gzhan dbang dang yongs grub la kun btags ngo bo nyid du sgro btags nas/ gzhan dbang dang yongs grub la kun btags pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid du rjes su tha snyad 'dogs te ji lta ji ltar tha snyad 'dogs pa de lta de ltar tha snyad btags pa'i yongs su bsgos pa'i sems tha snyad btags pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'am/ tha snyad btags pa bag la nyal gyis gzhan dbang dang yongs grub la kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid du mngon par zhen no/ / ji ltar mngon par zhen pa de ltar gzhan dbang gi ngo bo nyid bskyed de/ gzhi des na nyon mongs pa dang / la sa kyis dang / skye pa'i nyon mongs pas nyon mongs par 'gyur/ yun ring bor sems can dmyal ba'am/ dud 'gro'am/ yi dwags 'am/ lha'am/ lha ma yina'am/mi rnams kyi nang du kun tu rgyug cing 'khor bar 'gyur te/ zhes pas chos kyi bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa mthar thug tu bstan/ de man chad na gzhung du drangs pa'i lung rnams 'byung / legs bshad las/ gzugs sogs rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa de/ tshad mas grub ma grub gnyis yod do/ / zhes pa gzugs sogs rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa yod rgyu dang / de rang mtshan gyis grub pa med rgyu yin pa ches gsal mod/ yig char/ gzugs sogs zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par sgro btags pa yod rgyu/sgro btags pa ltar grub pa med rgyur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan du drangs pa mtshar tshes bdag dkag pa'i med dgag blo yul du 'char ba la mkho ba ni dgag bya'i don sbyi yin mod/ de mkho ba la bsam nas dgag bya mkho bar bshad/ mkho bar thal/ dgos par thal sogs 'phangs na brtag yig char ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag 'dzin phra mo ma yin par thal/ gzugs gzugs bzhin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par snang ba de rang mtshan gyis ma grub pa chos kyi bdag med phra mo ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la khyab pa med kyang / yig cha'i lugs la gzugs gzugs 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub par snang ba de ngo bo la kun btags pa'i kun btags yin stabs/gcig shos chos kyi bdag med yin na 'di rang mtshan gyi ma grub pa'ang chos kyi bdag med phra mor 'gyur ba la de ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ yig char/ rtags gnyis so so nas grub ste zhes pa rtags phyi ma gnyis la go dgos / brda rtog par 'jog pa'i khungs ma mthong / sngar kun btags rang mtshan gyis ma grub pa chos kyi bdag med ma yin par yang yang bshad mod/ rtsod spong thad du med rgyu'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid shes 182 ri

bya la mi srid pa dang / de'i mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid yin na zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pas khyab par bshad pas de med pa chos kyi bdag med las 'os med/ yig cha gang la'ang mi bstun pa'i dpang du byas na/ 'dir bstan 'khor lo dang bor phung po rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyang bka' stsal par gsungs pa'i rang mtshan dang /kun btags la med rgyu'i mtshan nyid kyis ngo bo nyid dang / ming brdas bzhag tsam min pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa rnams don gcig pa dang / 'khor lo dang bo'i sgras zin tshad mas bsal ba la phung sogs kyi ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa 'jog/ des na de 'dra'i kun btags rang mtshan gyis grub pa chos bdag dang / der 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag 'dzin dang / de med pa chos kyi bdag med du 'jog byas na stabs bde/ legs bshad las/ chos rnams la ngo bo dang khyad par du btags pa'i kun btags ni chos kyi khams dang skye mched yin pas/ de gnyis la cha ma phye bar rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par gsu ngas pa la yang drang don yin/ zhes pa'i don/ 'khor lo dang por chos kyi khams dang skye mched gnyis la cha ma phye bar rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par gsungs pa drang don yin par thal/ chos kyi khams dang skye mched gnyis rang gi mtshan nyi da kyis ma grub pa'i phyir/ ma khyab ste / gzugs sogs lnga bo ma gtogs pa'i chos kyi khams dang skye mched las 'khor lo dang bor 'dus ma byas rnams rang mtshan gyis grub par gsungs pa min gyi/ 'dus byas rnams rang mtshan gyis grub par gsungs pa yin no zhe na/ khyab pa yod par thal/ ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags de chos kyi khams dang skye mched yin pa gang zhig de 'dra'i kun btags de rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don yin nam gsungs/ yig char mi bstun na 'dir bstan 'khor lo dang bor chos kyi khams dang skye mched la cha ma phye bar rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par gsungs pa'i cha nas kyang drangs don du khas blangs chog/ yig char/ rtag gcig rang dbang can du 'dzin pa'i blo de mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba ma yin bar thal/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin rags pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ma shes/ yig char/ ngo bo nyid med pa gsum po gang gi yang ngo bo nyid med pa zhig yongs/ grub du 'jog mi rigs par thal/ zhes sogs/ legs bshad las/ ngo bo nyid de kho nas zhes kun btags kyi ngo bo nyid gong du smos pa la gsungs nas/ kho nas zhes pas ni gzhan gcod pas sogs kyi don 'grel ba yin shas che yang / de ngo bo nyid gsum la sbyar na go sla bas ngo bo nyid med pa 183

gsum zhes sbyar ba la 'khrul gzhi ma gtogs dgos pa med 'dra/ skabs 'dir mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa kun btags ma yin par bshad pas kun btags dang mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa don gcig pa'i bshad lugs dang 'gal/ mtshan nyid gsum dang ngo bo nyid med pa gsum don mi gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan du lung drangs pa sgrub byed du 'gro dka'/ / skye ba ngo bo med pa'i skabs/ dka' 'grel du/ rgyu rkyen yod med gang la'ang ma ltos par bshad pa/ rgyu yod kyang rung med kyang rung bas rgyu la ma ltos pa'i don nam/ bye smra'i lugs la mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu dang / lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu sogs rgyu 'bras dus mnyam pa rnams rang dang bdag nyid gcig pa'i rgyu las skye bar 'dod/ rdzas gcig pa'i sems sems byung dang / rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus kyi gong bu'i tshogs pa na yod pa'i rdul rdzas rnams phan tshun rgyu 'bras gnyis gar khas len/dka' 'grel du/ rgyu 'bras gcig gcig gi dus na de dang de'i ngo bor yod par gsungs pa'i don/ myu gu de sa bon gyi dus su sa bon gyi ngo bor yod kyang / sa bon gyi dus su med/ sangs 'phags de rang dang rgyud gcig pa'i tshogs lam pa'i ngo bor yod kyang / des de dus su med zer ki 'dug/ sa bon gyi dus su sa bon gyi ngo bor yod na dus der yod pas ma khyab/ dka' 'grel du/ ngo bo nyid med pa gsum chos thams cad kyi steng du 'jog pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad pas/ yig char 'dus ma byas la skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa'i don tshang mi dgos par bshad pa la dogs pa gnang /yig char/ skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa'i don don dam par rang mtshan gyis grub pa'i skye ba med pa la byed par thal/ thal rang gnyis kyis de ltar bshad pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ces gsungs mod/ dka' 'grel du/ don dam par zhes pa ma sbyar ba'i yig cha 'i lung zhig drangs nas de'i don rgyas par bkral/ dka' 'grel du/ phyi ma ma khyab gsungs pa rang rgyud pas de ltar 'dod na yig cha mi 'thad pas ma khyab ces pa yin pas /dka' 'grel lugs la'ang don dam pa'i khyad par sbyar dgos 'dra/ yig char/ rgyu rkyen la ma ltos par bdag nyid gcig pa'i rgyu las skye pa la byed ces pa rang dbang gis skye ba la go dgos/ yig char/ bsdu bar 'chad pa na 'du byed rnams chos can sogs/ bsdu pa'i don sbyor yin/ / dka' 'grel don/ 'jog tshul dang dang bo'i don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa stong nyid yin par thal/ dmigs pa mthar thug tu ma grub pa de'i don yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ces pa'o/ gzhan dbang bar chad med lam gyi gzigs ngor ma grub pa stong nyid yin na/ gzhan dbang de'i ngor yod par 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin yod dgos/ de yod na gzhan dbang don dam bden par 184

'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin kyang yod dam/ de 'dra'i bdag 'dzin med par bshad pas dogs/ dka' 'grel du/ ye shes dam pa'i don zhes pa de yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa khyab 'grigs tu 'gro tshul ma shes/ dka' 'grel don/ kho na re/ gzhan dbang don dam bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin yod par thal/ gzhan dbang phyi don du grub ma grub dpyod pa'i dpyad bzod du 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin yod pas so zhe na/gzhan dbang phyi don grub ma grub dpyod pa'i rig shes kyis dpyad bzod du 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin mdo sde ba'i rgyud na yod kyang / des stong ba rtogs pa la stong nyid rtogs dgos pas mi 'dra zhes pa'o 4/ legs bshad las/ gzugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bar la ngo bo nyid du btags pa kun btags su bshad pa'i ngo ba nyid ni gshis sam rang bzhin la bya zhing sogs kyi skabs/ gzhan dbang gnas lugs su grub pa kun btags su gsungs pas/ des na der 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin yod dam/ yod na sems tsam pa'i lus la'ang dogs/ chos 'byung gis/ thal rang gnyis la gzhan dbang rnam dag lam gyi dmigs pa mthar thug tu 'gyur snyam pa'i dogs pa che tshul bshad pa rig pa'i 'phul mtshams 'dra ba zhig tu 'gyur/ sgra dang sgra mi rtag pa gnyis grub bde rdzas gcig yin pas sgra 'dzin mngon sum gyi snang yul du 'dra yang / sgra rtogs la gcig shos ma rtogs zer/ rnam 'grel ṭīka chen dbur/ sgra 'dzin mngon sum gyis sgra mi rtag pa mthong ma mthong sogs rtsod pa mang / ke tshang drangs nges su/ sems las logs su mthong rgyu gzhan med pas sems don dam dpyod pa'i rnyed don mthar thug tu 'gyur snyam pa'i dogs pa che zer/ sems tsam lugs la/ lta ba gtan la 'bebs skabs sems las logs su mthong rgyu med na/ sems rnyed don mthar thug tu song zin pas/ rnyed don mthar thug tu 'gyur snyam pa'i dogs pa ga la yod nang 'gal/ dka' 'grel du/ de 'gog skabs/ sems tsam pa la de lta bu'i khas len med pas sogs kyi don sems tsam pa la sems las logs su mthong rgyu med do/ /zhes pas khas len med pas/ de'i lugs la de nyid rgyu mtshan du bkod nas/sems rnyed don mthar thug tu 'gyur snyam pa'i dogs pa gcod pa mdo las gsungs pa'i gnas med pa'i phyir te/ sems tsam pas sems rnam dag lam gyi dmigs pa mthar thug tu mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dgongs 'grel sogs las/ chos bdag bkag pa'i med dgag dmigs pa mthar thug tu bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes 'gog/tshe brtan gyis/ gzhan dbang ya nga dgag bya bcad tsam min pas dogs pa med par thal lo/ / sogs dgag pa mang bo byas pa la 'brel cher med pa 'dra/ sems tsam 185

pa la gzhan dbang bden grub dmigs pa mthar thug tu khas blangs pa'i khas len med pas zhes sogs khyab 'grigs 'phangs pa la yang 'brel med 'dra/ spyir gzhan dbang la dogs pa che na gzhan dbang gi gsal pa'i dbye ba thams cad la dogs pa che dgos pas sems la yang dogs pa yod zer dgos 'dra/ chos 'byung lugs la/ kun btags rang 'dzin rtogs pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pas stong bar bstan pa na kun btags dmigs pa mthar thug tu 'gyur ram snyam pa'i dogs pa med par thal/stong gzhi yin yang bden par ma grub pas rang steng gi gzhan dbang kun btags la dogs pa chung zer dgos sam dogs pa/ dka' 'grel du/ pra sti 'gog skabs de'i dmigs yul yin na/ de'i 'dzin stangs kyi yul du 'gyur snyam pa'i dogs pa mi che gsungs pa'i skyon 'jug na legs bshad la yang skyon 'jug pa 'dra pas bshad dka' stong ba nyid stong ba nyid rtog pa'i ye shes de/ stong nyid rnyed pa'i ye shes yin par thal/stong nyid rnyed bya'i yul du byed pa ye shes yin par thal/ stong nyid rnyed don du byed pa'i ye shes yin par thal lta bu'i dogs pa/ legs bshad du drangs pa'i byams zhus las ming dang 'du shes dang / btags pa dang / tha snyad gang yin pa 'di ni rnam par btags pa'i gzugs so/ / zhes dang / legs bshad las/ sngar bstan pa'i brjod bya dang rnam rtog kyang rnam btags su bshad par gzung ste/ 'dis rnam par btags pa dang / 'di la rnam par btags pa'i gzhi gnyis so/ / zhes 'dogs byed kyi rtog pa rnam btags sam gzhan dbang du bshad/ sems tsam pas byams zhus kyi drang nges sogs khas mi len kyang / mtshan nyid gsum gyi 'jog tshul khas len dgos pas/ rje btsun pas chos de rtogs pa'i tshad ma chos de'i gzhan dbang tu 'jog pa'i khongs su 'gro'am/ kho bo tsho'i yig char 'di drangs mi 'dug/nyon mongs rtog pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi chos nyid nyon mongs kyi chos nyid yin na ha cang thal bas/ de gnyis rdzas mi gcig zer ram/ sngar gyi kun btags ming brdas bzhag tsam skabs/ tshe brtan gyis/ chos gang yin yang de'i don blo la 'char ba ming gi tha snyad la nges par ltos dgos pa ming brdas bzhag tsam dang / de ltar ltos mi dgos pa ming brdas ma bzhag par 'jog dgos pa dang / ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags ming brdas bzhag tsam du 'dod mod/ gzugs rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa chos can/ khyod kyi don 'char ba ming la ltos par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ brda mi shes pa la khyod kyi spyi 'char ba med par thal lo/ / 'dod ma nus te/brda mi shes pa la gzugs rtog pa'i zhen gzhir yin pa rang mtshan gyis grub par 'dzin 186

pa yod pas so/ / legs bshad las/ gzugs sogs rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa de brda mi shes pa la yang dgag bya sgro 'dogs yod la gsungs pa dang 'gal/ tshe brtan ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags ming brda tsam gyis 'jog nus tshul gzhung rang las dngos su gsungs zer mod/ yod rgyu'i kun btags la bsam pa yin na/ ming brda tsam gyis 'jog ga la nus te/ tshad ma la ltos pa'i phyir/tshe brtan gyis/ ming brda tsam gyis bzhag pa'i chos zhig mi srid dam snyam ze/ra ba dang / tsam sgra snga phyi'i khyad med zer ba nang 'gal/ tshe brtan lugs la/ ri bong can zla ba zhes pa'i sgras brjod rung yin pa ming brda tsam gyis bzhag pa yin zer/ rang lugs la de ming brda'i dbang gis bzhag pa yin yang ming brda tsam gyis bzhag pa ga la yin/ming brda tsam gyis bzhag pa'i chos med do/ / legs bshad las/ ming tsam gyis bzhag pa'i kun btags shes bya la mi srid pa yin gsungs bas so/ / phyogs snga mas/nam mkha' ming brdas bzhag tsam min te/ ming brdas 'jog mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ba lang lta bu g.yangs mthon por phyin tshe nam mkha'i spyi shar te 'jigs skrag skye pa'i phyir/zhes zer ba la/ gung thang nas// dgag bya'i chos bdag chos can/ ming brdas bzhag tsam ma yin par thal/ brda mi shes pa la'ang 'char ba'i phyir zhes 'phangs pa/tshe brtan gyis skyon 'jug pa'i gnas med zer mod/ 'dod lan mi thebs pa shes sla la/ ma khyab na rang gi khas blangs dang 'gal/ ma grub na/ brda mi shes pa la chos bdag gi rnam/ pa 'char bar thal/ de'i rgyud kyi bdag 'dzin la 'char ba'i phyir/tshe brtan na re/ brda mi shes pa'i rgyud kyi chos kyi bdag 'dzin des chos bdag gi don 'jog shes par thal sogs 'phangs pa/ nam mkha' dang chos bdag gnyis cha gcig nas 'dra na cha thams cad nas 'dra dgos par thal bsam mam/ rang lugs brda zhes pa rtog pa la byed byas par/ brda mi shes pa'i rgyud la brda yod par thal sogs 'phungs pa cung zad rno/ legs bshad du/ yod rgyu'i kun btags mang bo cig gsungs mthar de dag gi mang bo zhig ming dang brdas 'jog mi nas pa'i yod pa yin gsungs pa la/ tshe brtan gyis/ mang bo zhig ming brda tsam gyis 'jog mi nus par bshad pa'i shugs la nyung ngu zhig ming brda tsam gyis 'jog nus par bstan snyam du bsam/ rang lugs la de don ga 'dra yin brtag/ chos 'byung gis rang rgyal gyis zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis stong ba rtogs gsungs pa phar phyin gyi lugs ltar rtogs rigs gsum 'gal pa'i dbang du byas/ yig char/ kun btags la de'i phyir zhes pa/ kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub nga de ma yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don 187

nam/ yig char/ zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis stong ba dang chos kyi bdag med phra mo gnyis bo de zhes pa'i gnyis kyi sgra la dgos pa med 'dra/ rang rgyal rigs nges dgra bcom sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' smra ba yin stabs/ theg chen gyi sde snod la sbyangs nas gnyis stong sgrub byed kyi rigs pa thams cad shes kyang / de la brten nas gnyis stong rtogs pa gtan med pa rig dman pa'i dbang gis yin zer ram brtag/ de 'dra'i dgra bcom gyi rgyud na the tshom med stabs gzugs phyi rol don du grub bam ma grub snyam pa'i the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod ma chod brtag/ phar phyin byams gzhung du/bem po med pa'i phyir te phyi don med pa'i phyir/ zhes bem po dang phyi don rnam grangs lta bur bshad/ 'dir mi 'dra bar bshad/ yig char legs ldan gyis 'a dus byas thams cad bem bor khas len par thal/ des phyi don du khas len pa gang zhig phyi don dang bem po 'dra pa'i phyir/ zhes pa de gnyis 'dra yang / gcig khas blangs na gcig shos khas len pas khyab pa yod mi dgos bsam/ legs ldan gyis shes pa phyi don du 'dod tshul shes pa rnams rang 'dzin tshad ma dang rdzas tha dad pa'i rgyur 'dod pa'o/ / legs bshad don/ gzhan dbang rnam dag lam gyi dmigs par 'gyur ram snyam pa'i dogs pa skye mkhan dngos su med pa dang / dogs pa khongs slong gis de 'dra skye mkhan yod na bsal pa'i phyir/ gzhan dbang don dam pa ngo bo nyid med par bstan byas na bde/ kun btags dgag la sbyar bas de 'dra'i dogs pa mi dgos/'jam bshad drang nges zin bris las/ gzhi grub na don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa yin pas khyab par bshad pa gzhi grub tshad thams cad rang steng gi gzhan dbang du 'gyur ba la bsam/ sgra 'dzin mngon sum la sgra mi rtag pa mngon gyur du khas blangs na/mngon sum du mthong bar thal bas/ de la sgra mi rtag pa mngon sum du snang yang mngon gyur min lkog gyur yin zer dgos/ brjod snang bas gzhan stong chen mo de dgongs 'grel las bshad pa'i don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa yin zer min dpyad/ sum cu ba'i 'grel ba las/ rang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis yod pa ltar zhes pa mtshan nyid gsum la rang rang gi thun mong min pa'i 'jog byed yod pa lta bu'am/ dka' 'grel du/ gang zag gi bdag med phra mo kun btags yin par thal/ yod pa gang zhig/gzhan dbang yongs grub gnyis gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir zhes pa la/ gang zag gi bdag med phra mo yod pa gang zhig zhes sbyar na rtsod gzhi'i steng du khyab pa yod/ sbyir na ma khyab ste/ gzhan dbang yongs grub gnyis ka chos can/ sems tsam pa dang /thal 'gyur gnyis kyis myang 'das dang 'gog bden stong nyid du 'dod pas/ gang 188

zag gi bdag med yongs grub min na nyan rang gi myang 'das bden med du thal pa dgongs dag/ gzhan dbang yongs grub gnyis bden par gru ba mnyam yin dgos pa'i rtsa ba 'khor 'das gnyis bden mnyam yin pa la thug/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i sdug bsngal 'khor ba dang 'gog pa myang 'das 'dra/ rje btsun du gang zag gi bdag med yongs grub de bzhin nyid don dam thams cad yin par bshad nas stong thun lugs la yongs grub yin na/ stong nyid yin pas ma khyab zer ba bshad stabs bde/ sgo mang dang / dka' 'grel du/ stong thun gyi lugs rang lugs dang bsres pas 'gal pa cung zad yod 'dra/ tshe brtan gyis/ stong thun lugs la stong ba nyid ni 'di la yod ces pas gnod byed ston mi nus zer mod dbu mthar/ gang zag dang ni chos rnams kyi/ / dngos po med 'dir stong ba nyid/ / ces bshad pas/gang zag gi bdag med stong nyid tsam yin na/ bden grub tsam yin par thal lo/ /tshe brtan gyis/ stong ba nyid yin par thal/ rnam dag lam gyi dmigs pa mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la khyab pa sgrub byed med zer mod/ ye shes dam pa'i don dang stong nyid rnams grangs su dbu mtha' las bshad pa las lhag pa'i sgrub byed ga la dgos/ rtags gsal de 'dra gung thang gsungs du med pas gleng btab pa 'dra/gzhung de rang rgyud pa'i lugs la'ang don dam bden par gsungs par thal lo/ /zhes pa stong thun du sems tsam pa dang rang rgyud pa zhes yod pa la bsam/ yig char/gang zag gi bdag med spyi ldog la dgongs gsungs pa rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag med la byed na de 'dra'i bdag med khas blangs pas gang zag gi khas blangs pa'i go e chod/ mi chod na/ des phyag brgya bzhi'i bdag med kyi go mi chod par thal lo/ / go chod na mang bkur sde lngas bdag khas mi len par thal/ bdag med khas len pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gang zag gi bdag yod par ston pa'i mdo dang / de'i gdul bya sogs med par thal lo/ / bdag med phra rags gnyis su ma phye ba'i bdag med don dam min na/ stong nyid min par thal/ bdag med min par thal/'dod na/ des gnyis su ma phye pa'i bdag khegs na bdag khegs pa min par thal lo/ / zhes pa dka' 'grel gyi don no/ / stong thun du/ sems tsam lugs 'a/ yongs grub ni bdag 'dzin gnyis kyis kun btags pa ltar grub pas stong ba'i de bzhin nyid la bshad pa dang / de'i lugs la/ nyan rang rnams kyi nyon mongs spong ba'i ye shes kyi yongs grub la dmigs pa mi srid par smra par gsungs pa dang / gang zag gi bdag 'gog pa'i rig pa kun rdzob dpyod byed du gsungs pa rnams la nang 189

'gal cung zad yod 'dra/ dka' 'grel ltar na nang 'gal min/ dbu ma ba'i rig pa'i 'phul mtshams yin zer dgos mod/ stong thun las ye shes kyi dmigs pa gzhan dbang yin pas khyab cing sogs 'phul mtshams la sbyar na 'bru sno na dka'/ stong nyid yin par thal/ 'dus ma byas gang zhig bden par grub pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la/gzhan dbang yongs grub gnyis ka dang bden grub sogs ma khyab pa'i skyon yod mod/tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su grangs nge sa par bshad pa ltar/ bden grub la gzha na dbang dang / yongs grub gnyis su kha tshon chod par bshad chog pa la bsam /dbus mthar/ stong ba nyid ni mdor bsdu naḥ/ zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings rnams rnam grangs so/ / zhes pa stong thun la gnod byed du 'gro ba 'dra/ ming gi rnam/ grangs zhes pa ltar na/ rnam grangs yin na don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pas khyab bam snyam yang / yig char/ rnam grangs la don gcig mi dgos zhes yang yang bshad/ gser phreng skabs gsum par theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa yin na/ de bzhin nyid stogs bas khyab kyang stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyab par bshad pa chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir sogs la bstan/ dbu ma'i yig char mang bkur sde lngas gang zag rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dzin pa bdag 'dzin lhan skyes dang / rtag gcig rang dbang can du 'dzin pa bdag 'dzin kun btags su bshad pa la rgyab rten dka'/ dka' 'grel du/ mang bkur sde lngas/ gang zag rang skya pa'i rdzas su dang rdzas kyis stong ba gang du yang khas mi len pas brjod med du 'dod par bshad pa grub mtha' chen mo'i tshig zin la brten pa yin yang / 'jug pa'i ṭīka chen las/ des gang zag phung bo las ngo bo tha dad pa dang / phung bo'i rang bzhin gang du'ang brjod du med pa dang / rtag pa dang mi rtag pa gang du yang brjod du med kyang / rdzas yod du 'dod par shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa dang 'gal/ grub mchan dngos smra ba'i grangs man chad du grub mtha' chen mo dang lcang skya grub mtha'i bshad tshul sogs 'di skor rgyas par bris 'dug/ blo gros rnam dag gi le'ur 'du byed dang don dam tha dad ma yin par gyur na zhes pa ldog pa tha dad min pa'o/ dgongs 'grel las/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo med pa nyid kyis rab tu phye ba gsungs pa'i don/ chos nyid yin na chos thams cad kyi ngo bo med pa nyid kyis rab tu phye pas ma khyab/ chos thams cad kyi steng na chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid med pa 'dra yang / bum pa'i chos nyid de bum steng gi chos bdag bkag pas rab tu phye ba yin gyis ka ba'i chos bdag bkag pas rab tu phye ba min/ khu re chen mor/ gzhi grub na mi rtag sogs bcu drug po gang rung yin 190

khyab zer mkhan yod zer ba bdag med pa la bsam/ sgyu ma gzhan dbang gi dper bzhag pa phyi don du snang yang phyi don gyi stong ba'i dper dang / zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyi grub par snang yang / des stong ba'i dpe gnyis kur sbyor/ dgongs 'grel don/gzhan dbang gi steng gi bdag med de'i don dam bden pa ma yin par thal/ bden pa gnyis ngo bo tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ de de'i don dam yin na ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur zhes pa'o/ bka' 'grel las/ thag khra sbrul snang blo 'khrul pa'i snang cha tsam yin pas 'jog byed gzhan med par gsungs pa de 'jog byed kyi tshad ma yod stabs/'khrul snang la ma ltos par 'jog byed med pa'i don byas na e dga'/ dka' 'grel du/ lugs 'dir gzhan dbang yongs grub bden grub dang / kun btags bden par med pa mdo'i dogs pa gcod tshul gyis 'grub par gsungs pa/ mdor gzhan dbang yongs grub rang mtshan gyis yod na kun btags kyang bzhag nus la gzhan dbang yongs grub rang mtshan gyis med na kun btags la yang bskur ba btab par gsungs pa de'o/ gzhan gyi ltar na rdzas la chags pa yis/ zhes pa/ 'jug ṭīka las/shes rab kyi rtsal med pas gzhan dbang gi rdzas shas tsam la bden par zhen pa'i chags pa yi sgo nas zhes so/ / bum pa ni rdzas min te gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rdzas ni dngos rdzas lta bu/ de 'dra'i sbyor ba 'god mkhan gyi rgol pa dngos su med/brtag pa mtha' bzung yin zhes na bde/ dka' 'grel du/ de las lhag pa'i 'gag rgyu zhig med ces pa mi shes pas/ rang bzhin gyis med na gtan med du 'gro zhes pa'i don nam/ zab pa brgyad ni/ skabs bzhi par sgom lam thad/ mar me dpe yi tshul gyi ni/ / zab mo'i chos rnam pa brgyad/ / ces par gsal/ dka' 'grel du/thag khra sprul gyis stong ba dang / chos nyid mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan bkod pa'i don ni chos nyid 'jog byed 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag yin la thag khra sbrul gyis stong bar 'jog byed gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i rtog pa yin par khyod kyis kyang 'dod pa'i phyir/rtags de yin na de gnyis mi mtshungs pas khyab ste/ chos nyid gang gi ngo bor 'jog pa'i mnyam bzhag gi ngor stong gzhi de khegs dgos la phyi ma sbrul gyis stong ba'i thag khra nges pa'i shugs kyis nges pas de'i snang cha tsam du zad pa'i phyir zhes pa'o/ lugs 'dir thag khra sbrul stong rtog pas btags tsam yin zhes pa'i rtog pa la rjes dpag yod med dpyad/ thag khra sbrul stong de kun btags yin pas rtog pas sgro btags tshul ni/thag khra rtog pas sbrul gyi stong ngo snyam du btags pa las/ sbrul stong gi ngo bo thag khra las zur du rnyed rgyu med pa la go dgos sa/ma/ bum pa ka bas stong ba sogs kyang rig 191

'gre/ ri bong can la zla ba zhes sgras brjod rung ni 'dod pa tsam gyis bzhag pa yin zer ba'i 'dod pa dang / de rtog pa'i tshad ma gnyis so sor 'jog pa ltar na kun btags 'dog byed rtog pa dang / de 'dzin pa'i tshad ma gnyis kyang so sor 'jog dgos sam/ dka' 'grel thad 'dir 'khor lo bar bas kun btags rang mtshan med par gsungs pa ltar 'dzin mi rung bar bshad pa ltar na/ 'khor lo bar ba'i sgras zin la kun btags gtan med du bstan snyam yang 'og tu 'khor lo bar bas thal 'gyur ba la gzugs skye med dang las 'bras med par ma bstan gsungs pa ltar na/'khor lo bar bas sgras zin la gzugs rang mtshan du med par gsungs pa de gtan med du gsungs pa min zer dgos sam/ sems tsam lugs gzhir bzhag na thal 'gyur bas las 'bras med par khas len zer mi rung bas/ 'khor lo bar bas de la de ltar ma bstan zer/ 'khor lo bar ba'i sgras zin ltar las 'bras rang mtshan gyis med par 'dzin pa de bskur 'debs kyi lta ba yin na/ las 'bras la bskur ba btab kyang med par ma bzung zer dgos sam/ dka' 'grel don/ chos thams cad rang mtshan gyis med pa 'di'i sgras zin ma yin par thal/ kun btags ra nga mtshan gyis med pa 'di'i sgras zin ma yin pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ces pa'o/ 'dir sgra sa zin sgra ji bzhin pa gsungs pa ma dag gam/ kha cig chos thams ca da rang mtshan gyis med pa 'di'i sgras zin ma yin par 'dod rigs te/ 'di'i sgras zin yin na tshad mas gsal dgos rgyur/ chos thams cad rang mtshan gyis ma grub pa'i phyir te zhes so/ /kun btags 'gres rkang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gras su med kyang / 'dus ma byas zhes pa'i zhar la bstan nam/ chos thams cad mtshan nyid gsum gang rung yin pas kun btags yin dgos pa chos thams cad dang mtshan nyid gsum sogs bden par med pa kun btags yin zer rgyun 'dug/ dka' 'grel ltar khas len na sbyor lugs skyon can gyi lan 'debs/ chos thams cad ces pa/ chos kyi gsal pa'i dbye ba thams cad la bsam pa yin na bden grub dang bden med gang du'ang khas len mi rung mod de gnyis gang rung yin zer ba bsdus gra tshor yod pa'i rigs 'bras sbyar na e dga'/ /dka' 'grel du/ dgag bya'i rang bzhin zhes dang / rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang mtshan gyis grub pa'i skye sogs med pa ma skyes sogs su gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhir bstan gsungs pa ltar na gzhung du kun btags la skye 'gag med pa dgongs gzhir gsungs pa dang 'gal lam/ skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa'i rang ldog gtso bor bkar ba min zhes pa'ang / yig cha dang bstun ched ma gtogs gsungs zin ltar 'dzin mi 192

dung ste/ skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa ma skyes pa sogs kyi dgongs gzhir dngos su ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad rigs pa'i slar 'jug pa ni 'chi ba lta bu dang /rgyun 'jig pa ni rgyun chad pa'o/ dgongs 'grel gyi rtag brtag pa'i dus ni snga ma snga ma'i dus dang / ther zug ther zug gi dus ni phyi ma phyi ma'i don du rjes bzhed pas de ltar yin mod/ dka' 'grel du/ nges gsungs mi dgos gsungs pa spyir gsungs rab las byung ba don du mar 'jug pa la go/ skye ba ngo bo nyid kyi med lugs ltar gzod ma nas zhi tshul dge rgyan las/ gzhan dbang de rkyen la ma ltos par rang gi bdag nyid kyi kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos su med pa la bshad/ gzhan dbang de rang dbang ba'i rgyu las skye nas nyon mongs kyi ma zhib pa min pa'o/ dka' 'grel du/dgongs 'grel gyi thad 'dir skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa ma skyes pa sogs kyi dgongs gzhir ma gsungs pa la bsams nas dgongs gzhi dris pa'i lan du de ma gsung gsungs/drang ba'i don gyi mdo brjod pa'i rnam pa'i sogs kyi thad du ngo bo nyid med pa gsum/ngo bo nyid med pa sogs lnga'i dgongs gzhir gsungs pa la bsam nas dgongs 'grel du de ma skyes pa sogs kyi dgongs gzhir gsung gsungs/ phyi ma'i don ngo bo nyid med pa gsum yongs rdzogs dang ci rigs la dgongs nas ngo bo nyid med pa ma skyes pa sogs gsungs pa'i don 'dra/ dka' 'grel du/ jo nang ba la bstan pa'i skyon gyis rang la gnod mod/ legs bshad du/ jo nang ba la skyon bstan pa dag gis mi gnod/dka' 'grel du/ kun btags rang mtshan gyis med pa la dgongs nas gzhan dbang ma skyes pa sogs su gsungs zer don med par bshad kyang / kun btags rang mtshan gyis med pa la dgongs nas chos thams cad ma skyes pa sogs su mdo las dngos su gsungs pa dang 'gal 'dra/ skyes pa ngo bo nyid med pa gzhan dbang kho na'i dgo ngas gzhi dang / don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa yongs grub kho na'i dgongs gzhir gsungs mod/ gzugs sogs chos thams cad kyi steng gi ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags rang mtshan gyis med pa gzugs sogs rang mtshan gyis med par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi yin pas mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa kun btags kho na'i dgongs gzhi ga la yin/ dka' 'grel du/ don med ma skyes pa sogs su gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi yin pa dang / de gzhan dbang ma skyes pa sogs su gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi min par bshad pa 'gal la khad/ mtshan nyid gsum po'i steng na go rgyu thun mong ma yin pa re yod gsungs pa ma shes/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rang dang rang gi mtshan nyid du zhes sogs kyis skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa ngo bo nyid med pa 193

sogs lnga'i dgongs gzhir bstan/ skye med brgyad ka chos thams cad skye ba mede par gsungs pas dgongs gzhi yin pas chos sku'i ngo bo gong 'phel du 'gro rgyu med pa'ang chos re re nas rang mtshan gyis skye ba med par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi yin zer dgos snyam yang / dka' 'grel du/ bum pa rang mtshan gyis skye ba med par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi min par bshad/ de ltar na chos re re nas skye ba med par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi min yang / dka' 'grel lugs la/ chos thams cad skye ba med par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi yin zer dam/ bum pa'i steng gi skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa bum pa kho na skye ba med par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhir 'jog bsam 'dra/de lta na dgongs 'grel du/ bum pa ka ba sogs chos re re nas rang mtshan gyis med par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi ma bstan par thal/ chos re re dang sbyar ba'i skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa ma bstan pas so/ / 'khor lo bar bas thal 'gyur ba la gzugs skye ba med par bstan na/ thal 'gyur ba'i de ltar 'dzin dgos pas/ sems tsam lugs gzhir zhog thal 'gyur ba'i phyag rgya bzhi dang / dkon mchog gsum sogs med par 'dzin par thal/ khas len par thal/ nang ba min par thal sogs kyi skyon 'byung bas thal 'gyur ba la de ltar ma bstan zer/ 'on kyang thal 'gyur ba'i rgyud na chos thams cad la bskur 'debs kyi lta ba yod zer dgos pas mchog gsum sogs la bskur ba btab ma btab dpyad/ bum pa'i ldog pa bum pa yod na yod/ med na med mod rtag pa yin zer ba dang / 'khor ba'i sngon mtha' dang nga'o snyam pa skye bo'i gzhir gyur ba'i nga'i snga phyi'i mtha' bzhag dka' yang mi rtag yin zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ma shes/ dri ma rang las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la ma zhugs zer dgos pas/ dri ma bum pa'i rang bzhin la ma zhugs pa bum pa'i stong nyid yin min brtag nyon mongs nyon mongs dang 'bral mi rung ba la bsams na dri ma dri ma'i rang bzhin la zhugs zer ram/ dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin la ma zhugs pa ni/ dri ma sems kyi gshes su ma grub pa'o/ de sems kyi stong nyid yin na sems nyon mongs kyi gshis su ma grub pa nyon mongs kyi stong nyid kyi thal lam brtag/ legs bshad du/ma skyes pa sogs kyi dgongs gzhi dang bo'i skabs kyi rang bzhin gyi myang 'das ni/kun btags nyon mongs/ kyi chos su ma grub pa la go dgos pas stong nyid min/dgongs gzhi gnyis pa'i skabs kyi rang bzhin gyi myang 'das kyang nyid stong nyon mongs dang bral ba ste nyon mongs min pa la zer 'dra bas brtag/ des na dka' 'grel du/rang bzhin gyi myang 'das stong nyid yin tshul rgyas par bshad pa gang dang 'brel brtag/ 194

stong nyid yin na khyod yin par gyur ba'i kun btags med pas ma khyab/ rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyi ma grub pa dang / gang zag gi bdag med chos can/ sems kyi rang bzhin la dri mas bslad pa ma zhugs kyang / sems kyi rang bzhin dri mas bslad pa yod par bshad pa yod bas ma/ mig shes la sngon po sngon por snang ba'i cha la 'khrul pa'i bslad pa ma zhugs/ sngon po phyi don du snang ba'i cha la bslad pa zhugs zer ba dang 'di mi 'dra/ 'di sems kyi gshis su zhugs pa'i dri ma ste yod na chos bdag tu 'gro/ dka' 'grel ltar na sems kyi rang bzhin dang ngo bo la khyad par yod 'dra/ dka' 'grel las/ dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin la zhugs na rang bzhin dang de gnyis 'bral mi rung bas sems kyi rang bzhin gzugs pa'i mnyam bzhag ngor nyon mongs yod par thal par bshad pa rig pa'i 'phul mtshams te/ dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin lam zhugs pa stong nyid yin par thal/ sems steng gi dri ma mnyam bzhag gi ngor med pa stong nyid yin pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu 'dug/ dri ma mnyam bzhag gi ngor med pa dri ma'i chos nyid dang / sems mnyam bzhag gi ngor med pa sems kyi chos nyid yin 'dra bas dpyad rgyu 'dug/ dka' 'grel las/ 'di'i stong gzhir sems yod ces pa'i 'di sgra/ dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin lam zhugs pa'o/ thar gsal gyi bdag 'dzin sems kyi rang bzhin la zhugs na bdag 'dzin gyi 'dzin stangs gnas lugs dang mthun par thal tshul ma shar/ rgyud bla dar ṭīka tu/ nyon mongs kyi sems dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas bslad pa yod la/ nyon mongs stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas gnas mi nas shing / de bzhin nyid la cung zad kyang dmigs mi nus pas/ sems kyi rang bzhin nyon mongs kyis bslad pa med par gsungs pa'i don/ sems dang nyon mongs ngo bo gcig tu skye ba yod pas de des bslad pa dang / nyon mongs dang sems kyi rang bzhin ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur ba med pas de des ma bslad par gsungs pa yin 'dra/ de lta na/ nyon mongs dang nyon mongs kyi chos nyid gnyis ngo bo gcig pas nyon mongs kyi rang gi chos nyid bslad par thal lo/ / dka' 'grel du/ ngo bo nyid du med pa gsum btags chos dang ngo bo nyid gsum gdags gzhir bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ma shar/ spyi mtshan dang nam mkha' sogs rnam grangs pa'i kun btags su bshad pa'i don/ sa sde ni/ chos so so'i dbye ba ston pa la rnam grangs kyi brda sbyar ba mang bas/ 'dir yang dbye nga rnam grangs mang bo'i kun btags zhes pa yin nam brtag/ dbu ma bden gnyis su/rig shes rjes dpag yul bcas yul dang yu la can ru rnam grangs pa'i don dam du 195

bshad pa don dam dngos min par btags pa la go dgos pas 'di dang mi 'dra/theg bsdus don/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa mngon par zhen pa ngag kun nas slong ba rnams rtog pa dang / tha snyad gang dang zhes pa sgra'am/ 'phags pa'i mnyam rjes ye shes dag pa'i gzhan dbang du bshad mod rjes thob ye shes ma rig pas bslad pa yin pas ma/ dag/ 'on kyang de mnyam bzhag dang rjes su mthun pas dag par bzhag 'dra/nyon mongs pa mi rgyu ba stong nyid kyi sgra don du bshad pa stong nyid der mnyam par bzhag pa'i rgyud la nyon mongs pa mi rgyu ba'am/ des stong ba kho nar 'gro pas zhes pa'am brtag / dge rgyam dka' 'grel du/ gang zag gi bdag med yongs grub min pa rje nyid kyi gsungs gi zur las yang yang byung gsungs pa/ legs bshad sems tsam thad kho na yin mi brtag/ dka' 'grel du/ gang zag gi bdag med kyi dbang du byas pa'i ngo bo nyid med pa gsum 'khor lo dang bo'i dgongs gzhi dang / chos kyi bdag med kyi dbang du byas pa'i ngo bo nyid med pa gsum 'khor lo bar ba'i dgongs gzhir bshad pa legs bshad las/ phung bo la sogs pa gzhan dbang dang / theg chen gyi mdo'i don du dgongs 'grel gyi bkralas/ phung po'i gzhan dbangs/ theg dman gyi mdo'i don du go nus la zhes pa'i don du dgongs/ pa yin mod/ legs bshad rang du/gang zag gi bdag med kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid gsum theg dman gyi mdo'i don du bshad pa ma gtogs dgongs gzhir bshad pa mi gsal/ rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis yod par gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhir ngo bo nyid med pa zhes bzhag na 'brel rgyu cher mi 'dug/ gang zag gi bdag med kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid gsum rtogs pa'i ched du chos rnams rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par gsungs/ des na de'i mtshan nyid gsum rtogs pa 'khor lo dang bo'i dgongs pa yin pa ma gtogs dgongs gzhi mi 'dra bsam/dgongs 'grel las/ kun gyi rnam dag lam ni gcig pu zhes pa/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa dang chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa gnyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bar 'dra ba dang / rnam par dag pa'ang gcig ste zhes pa/ theg pa mchog dman gyi thar ba rnams nyon mongs dag par 'dra ba'am/ 'khor lo dang bo'i dgongs gzhir yod pa tsam bzhag pa mthong ste go rgyu che/ rnam par rtog pa'i spyod yul zhes pa'i skabs kyi dmigs rkyen ni shes pa de dang rdzas gcig pas rkyen ba tags pa'o/ nus pa 'jog pa'i dmigs rkyen dmigs rkyen dngos yin/ rgya nag 'grel chen don/ 'du byed rtogs pa'i shes pa des rtags sam rgyu mtshan gyi rnam pas 'dzin pa la 'du byed kyi mtshan 196

mar bzhag/ 'jug pa'i don dam par sgra rtog gi yul min pa ni rtog pa'i sgra don gyi spyi la ma ltos par yul du byed mi nus pa'o/ de dang kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid kyi gnas gnyis don gcig tu 'gro tshul ma shar/ dbus mtha' las/ de yang gang gi ji ltar mthong / zhes pas/ stong nyid blo gang gis ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ba'i ye shes stong ba/ stong ba nyid stong ba nyid dang / gang phyir de yang stong ba nyid/ ces pas/ gang gi phyir stong ba nyid bsgom pa'i thob bya myang 'das stong ba don dam pa stong ba nyid du bstan tshul dpal chos bden gnyis las bshad/ dka' 'grel du/gzung ba dang 'dzin pa la sbyar ba'i khungs gar yod brtag/ dka' 'grel du/dbus mtha'i stong nyid bcu drug ston pa'i gzhung chos gzugs kyi sku sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa min gsungs yang / mtshan dang dpe byad thob bya'i phyir/ sogs kyis sku gnyis sgrub tshul sgras zin la bstan pa de sku gnyis sgrub pa'i dbang du byas te bstan pa min na gang yin brtag/ dka' 'grel du/ nyan rang gis srid mtha' mi khegs par bshad pa/ skabs gsum par byang sems lam la ltos pa'i srid mthar ltung tshul de'o/ / bden gnyis las/ stong nyid dgag bya bcad tsam du mi 'jog par sgrub pa rang dbang bar 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs bsal phyir dngos bo med pa stong ba nyid dang / dgag bya bcad tsam la bzhag pa na gtan med du 'gyur snyam pa'i bskur 'debs bsal phyir dngos po med pa'i dngos po nyid stong ba nyid bshad par bshad/ stong nyid de stong nyid gzhan
